reason: The card statement import would save me some retyping once a month, but I only do that job once a month and it takes me about ten minutes anyway, so 69 baht a month for it is hard to justify. The slip part needs me to remember to scan every day, and I already know I won't keep that up.
objection: I'll forget to scan the slips every day, and then the whole thing sits unused like my other budget apps.
would_change_my_mind: If the statement import alone cost much less, or if scanning a slip took a couple of seconds at the moment I pay, so I didn't have to remember it later.
